page_title: FIO 1-1 ACM | Fiorentina v AC Milan 11/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+8' Half-chance! Marco Brescianini (Fiorentina) plays a pass into the box, but Mike Maignan reacts well to snuff out the attack.
90+8' Corner kicks – 8:5.
90+8' Manor Solomon (Fiorentina) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
90+7' Mike Maignan pulls off a great save to deny Moise Kean (Fiorentina), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick low drive to the bottom left corner.
90+6' Marco Brescianini (Fiorentina) misses a great chance after firing a volley onto the crossbar of the goal.
90+6' Manor Solomon (Fiorentina) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
90+5' Marco Brescianini (Fiorentina) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. Now Fiorentina have a corner.
90+4' The referee demonstrates he won't tolerate this behaviour. Youssouf Fofana (AC Milan) is given a yellow card.
90+4' Koni De Winter (AC Milan) pulls the shirt of his opponent and only escapes without punishment due to the benevolence of the referee. A free kick is awarded to Fiorentina.
90+1' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Simon Sohm (Fiorentina) replaces Cher Ndour.
90' The fourth official shows 7 min. of added time.

90' 1 - 1 Youssouf Fofana passes the ball into the penalty area. Christopher Nkunku (AC Milan) collects it and quickly sends it into the right side of the goal via the post! The goalkeeper was helpless. 1:1!
88' Fine attempt! Samuele Ricci (AC Milan) collects a pass and manages to hold off the defender, then rifles in a shot from mid-range which unluckily swerves inches past the left post.
86' Christopher Nkunku (AC Milan) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates as he overhits the effort.
85' The resulting free kick from Nicolo Fagioli (Fiorentina) ends up in the gloves of the keeper.
84' Adrien Rabiot (AC Milan) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
84' Samuele Ricci (AC Milan) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
83' The referee signals a substitution. Luca Ranieri (Fiorentina) is brought on as a substitute for Robin Gosens.
83' Paolo Vanoli decides to make a substitution. Fabiano Parisi will be replaced by Niccolo Fortini (Fiorentina).
82' Manor Solomon (Fiorentina) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Albert Gudmundsson.
82' Davide Bartesaghi (AC Milan) lines up the resulting free kick from the edge of the box, but he produces a poor shot that goes high over the bar. The ball could have snow on it when it returns!
80' Nicolo Fagioli (Fiorentina) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
80' Nicolo Fagioli (Fiorentina) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle. AC Milan are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
80' Fabiano Parisi (Fiorentina) whips the ball into the box and Albert Gudmundsson takes a perfect touch to control it, but one of the defenders does well to intercept.
78' Adrien Rabiot (AC Milan) sends a cross into the box, but David de Gea comes off his line to gather the ball.
77' Samuele Ricci (AC Milan) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked.
76' Fabiano Parisi plays a short pass through to Marco Brescianini (Fiorentina) inside the box, but he balloons his effort high over the bar.

74' It looks like Strahinja Pavlovic (AC Milan) may be concussed after that challenge from an opposing player. He’s definitely coming off in line and Massimiliano Allegri replaces him with Christopher Nkunku.

73' What a wasted opportunity by Fabiano Parisi (Fiorentina)! He creates some space for himself inside the penalty box and unleashes a decent strike towards the bottom right corner, but Mike Maignan makes an astonishing save to thwart him.
72' Pietro Comuzzo (Fiorentina) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
71' Davide Bartesaghi (AC Milan) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.

68' Pietro Comuzzo (Fiorentina) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered. Strahinja Pavlovic (AC Milan) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
67' 13:7 – the total goal attempt statistics. 5:2 – this is the current number of shots on target.
66' 1 - 0 Albert Gudmundsson delivers a well-placed cross from the corner. Pietro Comuzzo (Fiorentina) wins the ball and powers an unstoppable header in off the right post. The score now reads 1:0.
65' Albert Gudmundsson (Fiorentina) will take a corner kick.
65' Here is a change. Rolando Mandragora is going off and Paolo Vanoli gives the last tactical orders to Marco Brescianini (Fiorentina).

65' Cher Ndour (Fiorentina) received a pass inside the box and sent a dangerous shot in on goal, but keep the champagne on ice as one of the defenders stepped in and blocked the effort. It's hard to say whether the keeper would have stopped it. Fiorentina have been awarded a corner kick.
63' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Ruben Loftus-Cheek departs the field of play to be replaced by Youssouf Fofana (AC Milan).
62' Robin Gosens (Fiorentina) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the roof of the net. His effort, however, is blocked by Mike Maignan, who pulls off a stunning save!
61' The referee blows his whistle, a clear handball by Christian Pulisic (AC Milan).
60' Massimiliano Allegri prepares a substitution. Ardon Jashari is replaced by Adrien Rabiot (AC Milan).
60' Massimiliano Allegri has decided to substitute Niclas Fullkrug and he is replaced by Rafael Leao (AC Milan).
60' Substitution. Pervis Estupinan is replaced by Davide Bartesaghi (AC Milan).
59' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) get himself out of a tight corner inside the box then shoots. The keeper leaps for the ball but it flies just wide of the left post.
58' David de Gea leaps to intercept the corner kick from Ardon Jashari (AC Milan).
56' Robin Gosens (Fiorentina) rises highest from the corner to head at goal, but his effort towards the underside of the crossbar is brilliantly kept out by the goalkeeper.
56' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
56' Dodo (Fiorentina) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players. Fiorentina have a corner.
53' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Pervis Estupinan (AC Milan) was quite harsh and Davide Massa didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
53' The free kick is taken by Samuele Ricci (AC Milan), but ball is cleared.

52' Fabiano Parisi (Fiorentina) collects a rebound a long way out and doesn't hesitate to release a goal-bound hammer of a shot. His attempt is precise and towards the middle of the target. It would have ended in the back of the net if it wasn't for Mike Maignan and his nice save.
51' Nicolo Fagioli (Fiorentina) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.

51' Nicolo Fagioli (Fiorentina) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Fiorentina will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

50' Albert Gudmundsson (Fiorentina) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Fiorentina.
49' Ardon Jashari (AC Milan) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play.
49' Christian Pulisic somehow manages to send in a good cross towards the centre of the box from an acute angle, but the header from Ruben Loftus-Cheek (AC Milan) flies well wide of the left post.
47' Koni De Winter (AC Milan) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Davide Massa blows for a foul. Fiorentina will take a free kick.
46' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
46' Dodo (Fiorentina) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Fiorentina have been awarded a corner kick.
46' The second half has just started.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+5' A pass from Dodo (Fiorentina) is intercepted by Mike Maignan and the move breaks down.
45+3' A poorly executed mid-range free kick by Samuele Ricci (AC Milan) as he fails to deliver a decent cross. The ball goes out of play and Fiorentina will have a goal kick.
45+2' Referee halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to Paolo Vanoli, then promptly shows him a RED CARD!
45+2' Paolo Vanoli isn't happy on the touchline after referee Davide Massa shows him a yellow card.
45' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.

43' Albert Gudmundsson (Fiorentina) shows off his amazing technique to get to the edge of the box by himself. He pulls the trigger but sends the ball miles wide of the right post. Nice run, but poor finish!
42' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) attempts an acrobatic volley on the edge of the box, but it's a wild effort and flies well wide of the left post.
42' A cross from the free kick is whipped in by Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina), but one of the defenders steps in and averts the threat.

40' Mike Maignan pulls off a decent save! Cher Ndour (Fiorentina) attempts to head home after a precise cross into the box. He aims his header towards the middle of the net, but the effort is kept out.
39' Samuele Ricci (AC Milan) controls a great pass from Alexis Saelemaekers on the edge of the box, steadies himself but his poor effort goes yards over the bar.
37' Samuele Ricci (AC Milan) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
36' Albert Gudmundsson (Fiorentina) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
34' Fabiano Parisi (Fiorentina) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
33' Total attempts – 2:4. The current number of shots on goal is 0:2.
33' Robin Gosens (Fiorentina) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
31' The referee shows a yellow card to Moise Kean (Fiorentina). No wonder. A clear yellow for bad language.
30' Robin Gosens (Fiorentina) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
29' Nicolo Fagioli (Fiorentina) fails to deliver a decent cross from a long-range free kick. The opposition's defence intercepts the effort.
29' Referee Davide Massa sees the trip by Samuele Ricci (AC Milan) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. Fiorentina win a free kick.
27' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) finds himself with a great opportunity! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, which whizzes just wide of the right post!
26' Albert Gudmundsson (Fiorentina) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box.

24' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) gets in a good position inside the box and is only inches away from getting on the end of a through ball from the edge of the area. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for AC Milan.
22' Matteo Gabbia (AC Milan) jumps inside the box to meet the resulting corner and steers his header into the roof of the net, but the goalkeeper pulls off an astonishing save to deny him.
22' Samuele Ricci (AC Milan) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.

21' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads towards the bottom right corner, but David de Gea shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.

21' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) attempted to send a defence-splitting pass into space where Niclas Fullkrug was lurking. It could have put him one-on-one with the goalkeeper, but one of the defending players somehow manages to avert the threat.
20' Matteo Gabbia (AC Milan) is penalised for holding. Davide Massa signals a set piece.
19' Robin Gosens (Fiorentina) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
18' Robin Gosens (Fiorentina) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
18' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) gets past David de Gea in goal, but is driven too wide and the angle is just too tough to find the net.
16' The ratio of the ball possession is 42:58.
15' Nicolo Fagioli (Fiorentina) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
14' Albert Gudmundsson (Fiorentina) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted. The referee points to the corner flag and Fiorentina will take a corner.
14' David de Gea (Fiorentina) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
12' The game is interrupted now, David de Gea (Fiorentina) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
11' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) dribbles into the box, but David de Gea is quick enough to come off his line and stop him.
11' Marin Pongracic (Fiorentina) misses a good chance to score. An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Marin Pongracic (Fiorentina) who rises for a header, but sends the ball well over the bar.
9' Albert Gudmundsson (Fiorentina) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
8' Nicolo Fagioli (Fiorentina) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while heading towards goal with the ball.
7' Ardon Jashari (AC Milan) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
6' Half-chance! Albert Gudmundsson (Fiorentina) plays a pass into the box, but Mike Maignan reacts well to snuff out the attack.
5' Ruben Loftus-Cheek received a clever long ball from Alexis Saelemaekers (AC Milan) which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert and managed to avert the threat.
3' Robin Gosens (Fiorentina) takes a shot after receiving a good pass, but his effort from the edge of the box goes just over the crossbar.
2' Marin Pongracic (Fiorentina) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot. The ball goes out of play and AC Milan will have a goal kick.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out at last! AC Milan will take the kick-off.
Davide Massa is the one to supervise the game today.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
